newsitem.title: USA: PhyMatrix sees Q2 in line with estimates.
newsitem.headline: PhyMatrix sees Q2 in line with estimates.

text.p: PhyMatrix Corp said Monday it expects second quarter earnings to be in line with estimates by analysts.
The company plans to report its earnings on September 4.
At the beginning of this year, four analysts estimated company earnings would be in the range of between $0.12 per share and $0.13 per share, the company said.
PhyMatrix went public earlier this year.
PhyMatrix, a physican practice management company, also announced it has signed an agreement to manage a management-services organization.

The Tampa Bay, Fla-based management-services organization will provide independent practice management services to the Tampa Bay Provider Group Inc and the Brandon Managed Care Network, representing more than 300 physicians.
The company said it also signed long-term management agreements with four group practices in Atlanta, South Florida and the Tampa Bay area, representing 20 physicians.
Terms of the agreements were not disclosed.
